    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCher's Valley party corn chipsLime guacamole and fresh tomato salsa with a bag of corn chipsHow to make it3 avocados3 limes1 onion, finely chopped1 small bunch coriander, chopped1 red chilli, finely chopped3 tomatoes, diced300g corn chipssalt, to tasteMash the avocados with the juice of two limes, half the onion, coriander and a little chilli.Mix the diced tomatoes with the remaining onion, lime juice and salt for salsa.Serve both with the corn chips.Mall pretzelsWarm soft pretzels rolled in cinnamon sugar, with a sweet cream cheese dipHow to make it4 soft pretzels40g butter, melted80g caster sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon125g cream cheese60g icing sugarBrush the pretzels with butter and roll in the sugar mixed with cinnamon.Warm at 200°C.Beat the cream cheese with the icing sugar for dipping.MainsTai's makeover sushi bowlsSushi rice topped with sashimi salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled gingerHow to make it300g sushi rice3 tbsp rice vinegar1 tbsp caster sugar400g sashimi salmon2 avocados1 Lebanese cucumber200g frozen edamame4 tbsp pickled ginger3 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oilRinse and cook the rice, then season with the rice vinegar and sugar and cool slightly.Slice the salmon, avocados and cucumber. Cook the edamame.Mix the soy with the sesame oil.Top bowls of rice with salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and dress.Mel's grilled snapper with salsa verdeCher's orders for her dad, grilled fish and no fatHow to make itAs written, serves 4Snapper fillets grilled skin side down until the skin crackles, a sharp parsley, caper and lemon salsa verde, and a crunchy green salad with avocado.Pat 4 snapper fillets (about 160g each) dry and score the skin.Chop 1 bunch parsley, half a bunch mint, 1 tbsp capers and 1 garlic clove, then mix with 100ml olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon and salt.Heat a heavy pan over high heat with 1 tbsp oil, lay the fish in skin side down, press for 10 seconds and cook 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute.Toss 150g mixed leaves, 1 sliced Lebanese cucumber and 1 sliced avocado with a little of the salsa.Serve the fish with salsa verde spooned over.SweetsAmber's pastel cupcakesVanilla cupcakes with pink and white buttercream and sprinklesHow to make it275g butter, soft150g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour125ml full cream milk300g icing sugar100g strawberries, mashed2 tbsp sprinklesHeat the oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole tin. Beat half the butter with the sugar, then the eggs.Fold in the flour and milk, divide between the cases and bake.Cool completely.Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and mix some with the mashed strawberry for pink.Pipe the icing and add sprinkles.DrinksRodeo Drive mango and strawberry smoothieMango, strawberry and banana blended thick with orange juiceHow to make it1 large mango300g strawberries1 banana500ml orange juice, cold100g Greek yoghurt2 cups icePeel and chop the mango and banana and hull the strawberries, keeping four for the rims.Blend the fruit with the orange juice, Greek yoghurt and ice on high until thick and smooth.Pour into tall glasses, perch a strawberry on each rim and serve with straws.
